fields.description: Full name of the field technician, used as the unique identifier for this record.
fields.label: Technician Name

fields.description: Current availability of the technician for dispatch, such as available, on a job, or off duty.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The system user account linked to this technician for login and mobile app access.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Whether the technician is an in-house employee or an external contractor.
fields.label: Worker Type

fields.description: The subcontracting company this technician works for when they are a contractor.
fields.label: Subcontractor

fields.description: The company that employs or engages this technician, used for access scoping.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Contact phone number for reaching the technician in the field.
fields.label: Phone

fields.description: The service territory or region this technician is assigned to cover.
fields.label: Service Territory

fields.description: Indicates the technician is currently active and eligible to be scheduled for jobs.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: The van or truck stock location for this technician, held as an ERPNext Warehouse.
fields.label: Van Warehouse

fields.description: Indicates the technician is currently clocked in and on the clock.
fields.label: Clocked In

fields.description: Date and time of the technician's most recent clock-in.
fields.label: Last Clock In

fields.description: Date and time of the technician's most recent clock-out.
fields.label: Last Clock Out

fields.description: Latitude of the technician's last reported GPS location.
fields.label: Last Seen Latitude

fields.description: Longitude of the technician's last reported GPS location.
fields.label: Last Seen Longitude

fields.label: Last Seen On
